synopsis: RELLIS-3D and ORAD-3D (2025) were used with Ground4D for off-road reconstruction [f4167]. A 2023 comparison of MAVS-simulated and real RELLIS-3D data for segmentation showed large domain-shift effects, highlighting a limitation in transferring simulated results to real off-road data [f4741, f12817]. RELLIS-3D is identified as a machine-mounted off-road dataset, but the research did not verify it or the other listed datasets [f5849, f12815]. No validation for off-road collision warning was found for these datasets or the listed open-source simulators; reconstruction use and segmentation comparisons therefore do not establish collision-warning validation [f4167, f4741, f5851, f12816].

relations.note: Both report large domain shifts between simulated data and RELLIS-3D.
Both identify the listed machine-mounted datasets as unverified in this research.
Extends the absence of collision-warning validation from datasets to named open-source simulators.
Specifies off-road collision-warning validation as a missing form of verification.
